caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent mug with a handle, rendered in shades of blue and gray. The mug is positioned upright in the center of a light beige background, which is unadorned and free of any other objects or patterns. The mug features a cylindrical body with a rounded rim, and its handle is curved, attached near the upper half of the mug and extending downward with a decorative touch near the base. The transparency of the mug allows for subtle variations in color intensity, suggesting the thickness and reflective quality of the glass material. The artist’s signature, "Van Silvay," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Mug
